confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no live prices or listings were checked. Restaurant anchors are moderately reliable for the tourist core. Room rates are less certain, and July is in the low, rainy season, so they may sit below peak. Cocktail and wine anchors are set relative to beer because direct knowledge is weaker. FX value is from rba.gov.au search results (4pm observation, 2026-10-15); the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Regional basis is tourist-oriented Southeast Asian destinations such as Luang Prabang (Laos) and Hoi An (Vietnam), with Phnom Penh as a lower-cost reference point. Visitor prices are commonly quoted in USD.
